metadata.name: Wheel of Peril
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A TV game show. Four contestants run a neon studio course of five stages while twelve audience members in the gallery above, behind safety glass, slam giant team-only buttons to pick each stage's doom: SPIKES or FLAMES, FLOOR or CRUSHERS, LASERS or MINES, SWEEPER or SQUEEZE, INFERNO or ROCKFALL. Each vote runs 8 s once a contestant steps in; then the gate at the end of the stage drops for 6 s. Ties go to the Wheel of Peril, a red-and-blue cross flipping a quarter turn on the back wall. The golden buzzer wins it for the contestant who reaches it; when the show clock runs out, the audience gets a buzzer of its own.

do.text: Welcome to WHEEL OF PERIL! Contestants, to your podiums. Audience, the buttons are yours!
GOLDEN BUZZER! We have a winner!
Time's up! Audience, hit your buzzer!
